meta.name: tbi
meta.notes: mTBI/post-concussion recovery dynamics — full-coverage port of the Frontiers Neurology 2018 causal-loop diagram (see models/tbi-paper-map.json for the source inventory and models/tbi-wiring-todo.json for paper connections not yet wired). Levels 0-100, 1 tick = 1 day. Weights are estimates; the loop structure is the faithful part. Extreme states can lock in (hysteresis is intentional).

nodes.name: Biomechanical Deformation of Neurons, Glia & Vasculature
nodes.notes: biomechanical deformation of neurons, glia & vasculature

nodes.name: Nonspecific Depolarization
nodes.notes: R-loop: depolarization → glutamate → NMDA → depolarization (acute, hours)

nodes.name: Ionic Na+:K+ Dysregulation
nodes.notes: B-loop with pump activity, energy-limited

nodes.name: Cellular Energy Imbalance
nodes.notes: supply vs demand crisis; drives the hypometabolic state

nodes.name: Neuroinflammation
nodes.notes: R-loops: cytokine response, microglia; B-loop: resolving immune response

nodes.name: Neuroinflammation adj
nodes.formula: ((clamp(0.4 * microenv + 0.3 * cytokine + 0.25 * astro + 0.3 * max(stress_in - 40, 0) - 0.35 * max(sleep_q_in - 50, 0) - 0.4 * immune_reg, 0, 100)) - inflammation) / 4

nodes.name: Glymphatic Clearing
nodes.notes: sleep-driven waste clearance — the sleep→brain-healing bridge

nodes.name: Pathological Microenvironment
nodes.notes: hysteresis kicker: sustained damage keeps the microenvironment pathological

nodes.name: Pathological Microenvironment adj
nodes.formula: ((clamp(0.45 * inflammation + 0.3 * bbb + 0.35 * metabolites_in + 0.25 * edema + if(damage_in > 60, 14, 0) - 0.35 * glymphatic, 0, 100)) - microenv) / 6

nodes.name: Axonal Injury
nodes.notes: slow structural injury; repairs over weeks

nodes.name: Tau Deposition
nodes.notes: ratchet: accumulates, effectively never clears — long-horizon risk

nodes.name: Cellular Repair Processes
nodes.notes: B-loop vs damage; starved by the energy crisis, fed by sleep & BDNF

nodes.name: Risk for Dementia & CTE
nodes.notes: ratchet, decade-scale

nodes.name: Predictive Brain State
nodes.notes: R-loop: bad predictions → error storms → worse calibration

nodes.name: Light / Sound Sensitivity
nodes.notes: sensitization accumulates over days

nodes.name: Cognitive Fatigue
nodes.notes: load vs capacity; B-loop through resting & cognitive rest

nodes.name: Cognitive Fatigue adj
nodes.formula: ((clamp(0.4 * sleep_debt + 0.55 * max(cogload_in - 0.8 * capacity_in, 0) + 0.2 * migraine - 0.3 * cognitive_rest + 8, 0, 100)) - cog_fatigue) / 1.5

nodes.name: Stress
nodes.notes: threshold kicker: entrenched mood disorder feeds stress

nodes.name: Stress adj
nodes.formula: ((clamp(0.55 * lifestress_in + 0.3 * fatigue_in + 0.25 * (60 - social_in) + 0.2 * mood_dis + 0.2 * pain_in + if(mood_dis > 65, 12, 0) - 0.25 * emotional_reg - 0.25 * coping_in, 0, 100)) - stress) / 3

nodes.name: Depression / Anxiety adj
nodes.formula: ((clamp(0.45 * stress + 0.3 * fatigue_in + 0.3 * (60 - social_in) + 0.15 * (85 - cognition_in) + 0.15 * pain_in - 0.2 * emotional_reg - 0.1 * coping_in, 0, 100)) - mood_dis) / 14

nodes.name: Social Functioning Ability
nodes.notes: R-loop: withdrawal → isolation → worse mood → withdrawal

nodes.name: Coping & Adaptation
nodes.notes: B-loop: symptoms create the need; adherence turns need into skills

nodes.name: Physical Exercise (effective)
nodes.notes: intolerance gates how much of the activity dial actually happens

nodes.name: Symptom Burden
nodes.formula: clamp(0.24 * fatigue + 0.16 * pain + 0.22 * (90 - cognition) + 0.16 * mood + 0.22 * sensorimotor, 0, 100)
nodes.notes: Composite outcome: gray = recovered, red = symptomatic

nodes.name: how to drive this
nodes.notes:
1 tick = 1 day. Defaults are a stable healthy system.
Concussion: raise Injury Severity, press R (reset) to seed t0, then play.
Or grind the psyche with the life dials — no injury needed.
Hover a widget: ⟲ resets it, 📌 pins it against influence.
Warning: extreme states can lock in — returning dials to defaults will NOT always re-balance (hysteresis, as in life).
